title: Circles powers telco personalization with OpenAI technology
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Circles uses the OpenAI API and Codex to power AI-native telco experiences, increasing ARPU by 22%, reducing churn by 9%, and improving development efficiency.
body:
Circles, a key innovator in telecommunications solutions, has unveiled a strategic integration of OpenAI's API and Codex to deliver what it describes as "AI-native telco experiences." This initiative marks a significant step towards embedding advanced artificial intelligence directly into the core of telecommunication services, aiming to fundamentally transform how providers engage with their customer base. The essence of this deployment is to harness OpenAI's sophisticated language models to craft highly personalized and intelligent interactions, moving beyond generic service offerings to truly individualized customer journeys.

The underlying technology leverages the OpenAI API for its robust natural language understanding and generation capabilities, enabling more intuitive and contextually aware customer interactions. The incorporation of Codex further suggests an application in automating or assisting with code-related tasks, potentially streamlining the development of new features or personalized service logic. This dual approach allows Circles to not only enhance customer-facing personalization, such as dynamic plan recommendations and proactive support, but also to bolster internal operational efficiency through AI-assisted development.

This announcement carries substantial weight for developers and researchers within the AI community. It provides a compelling, real-world demonstration of how integrating powerful large language models into traditional industries can yield significant business advantages. Circles reported impressive outcomes, including a 22% increase in Average Revenue Per User (ARPU), a 9% reduction in customer churn, and notable improvements in development efficiency. This case study highlights the immense potential for AI to drive tangible return on investment and revolutionize customer engagement in sectors ripe for digital transformation, offering a clear blueprint for future AI-first strategies.
